collection.title: Vauxhall Astra Van 2010 to 2012 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Vauxhall Astra Van 2010 - 2012 requires a 28" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 24" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
